# sauth_monitor (Resource)

The monitor records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String) Probe kind
- `name` (String) Display name

### Optional

- `config` (Attributes) Per kind settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scheduler runs the probe, default true
- `expected` (String) Value a dns answer, a keyword body or a json path must carry, required for keyword
- `expected_status` (Number) Http status an http probe must return, default 200
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between probes, or between beats for heartbeat, at least 1, default 60
- `target` (String) Url for http, keyword and json, host and port for tcp and certificate, a host for ping, a name for dns, omitted for disciple and heartbeat
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds before a probe fails, at least 1, default 10

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `days` (Number) Days before expiry at which a certificate probe fails, default 14
- `invert` (Boolean) Passes a keyword probe when the body lacks expected
- `path` (String) Dot path a json probe reads, required for json
- `record_type` (String) Record a dns probe resolves, default A
